answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 45712 Country: Bangladesh Title: Reciting Sura Fatiha in dream Question: (1) In my dream, I saw that I am reciting surah Fatiha and when I wake up from sleep my mother told me that you were reciting surah Fatiha in your dream. (2) In another night's dream, I saw a very beautiful girl, may be poor and then I was thinking myself that If I can marry like such beautiful girl. So what will be the interpretations? Answer ID: 45712 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 865/655/D=1434) (1) The dream is blessed one. In-shaAllah, you shall attain knowledge and wisdom. Recite the holy Quran regularly and follow the commandments and avoid prohibited acts. (2) This dream is also blessed one. In-shaAllah, you shall pass your days in good way. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
